# Clip N Curl

> Family hair salon based in Austin, Texas. Clip N Curl on Manchaca has done cuts, color, perms and prom updos for South Austin families for more than fifty years, and regulars say they feel at home the minute they walk in.

- Phone: (512) 444-3435
- Based in: Austin, TX
- Nearby areas: Austin, Sunset Valley, Manchaca, Buda, Kyle
- Yelp rating: 4.4 from 17 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/clip-n-curl/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/clip-n-curl/book.html

## Services
- Cuts & styling: Women's, men's and kids' cuts, matched to the look you bring in.
- Color & highlights: Root touch-ups, all-over color and highlights, including color rescues.
- Perms & relaxers: Classic perms and relaxers from stylists who have done them for decades.
- Prom & event updos: Updos and curls for prom, weddings and big nights.

## About
Clip N Curl is a home-grown salon on Manchaca Road that one regular says has been around for fifty-plus years and is always a full house. The stylists, including Darlene, Linda and Yolanda in reviews, do women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, highlights, perms, relaxers, blowouts and updos. Clients come back for years. One says Darlene has done her hair for about eight years and restored it to long, healthy hair; another trusts Yolanda with every perm. Walk in with a cut in mind and they will match it.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment at Clip N Curl?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (512) 444-3435 or book online and Clip N Curl will confirm by text.
- Q: Where is Clip N Curl?
  A: 5700 Manchaca Rd, Austin, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: Do you cut and color all hair types?
  A: Yes. Women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, highlights and styling for every hair type.
- Q: Can I bring inspiration photos?
  A: Please do. Photos help your stylist match the cut or color you have in mind.
- Q: What do clients say about Clip N Curl?
  A: Clip N Curl is rated 4.4 stars from 17 Yelp reviews. Clients mention friendly stylists who treat you like family, great color from Darlene and years of loyal regulars.
- Q: Do you do game-day styles?
  A: Yes. Burnt-orange ribbons and braids for Longhorns Saturdays, or Austin FC green for match night. Just ask when you book.
